acceptance.output_evidence: SOURCE: opal-data-irpt irpt/cottonwood/state/vendor_documents/ART-ac668d3baaab.../ (582,765 bytes, read in memory, removed after use), page 1 title 'Portfolio Overview', 23 pages, no template id in the file (row IRPT_YCDGEN-W2-S2). SKELETON: map_pdf lists 283 elements; 42 per-holding or per-fund data rows collapse into 7 per-table elements and 1 text element (page 5 'No data available' message, an all-bold line the skeleton cannot see) is added by hand: 249 in the map. TABLES: 22 table elements (a metric row of Risk Info, Periodic and Annual Return, Drawdown, Risk/Reward, the 7 per-holding or per-fund tables on pages 9-13, the settings and fee rows on page 14). NUMBERS: 158 labelled single values (pages 2-6 and 8, as the section's own label). Not listed as elements by design: the page-chrome logos and footers, the legend swatches. Known limits for the grader: the Risk/Reward Scatter chart's holding points are inside the one scatter chart element; the Style Box is listed as 9 number elements, not as a drawn grid; the wrapped label '(VaR) 5 percent' is folded into the Monthly Value at Risk row's label.
acceptance.denominator: 249 map elements over 23 of 23 pages; 13 of 13 non-chrome images are chart elements; value counts per element are in the skeleton (n_values), the values themselves are kept out of git (C-FIRM)
